activity_summary: Going out of the churchyard into Cheapside, you tried the word: sweet, like a pippin, like a child's physic. A man in Cambridge you never saw. Thirty-one years, and it comes in a margin. You laughed with your shoulders as far as the Stocks.

facets.activity: Tried the word sweet on the way into Cheapside

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A man in Cambridge whom I never saw. Thirty-one years, and it comes in a margin.
